purpose: Search for a ProcureHarness agentic design-pattern skeleton that improves the long-horizon procurement quality/economic-efficiency frontier before adding memory, knowledge graphs, forecasting, dynamic model routing, or self-improvement.

scientific_scope.claim_if_success: A frozen ProcureHarness design pattern produces a better quality/economic-efficiency tradeoff than matched Coverage+Repair and ReAct comparators on a new untouched final method test.
forbidden_claims: global optimum over all possible agent architectures
memory, knowledge-graph, forecasting, model-routing, or self-improvement gains before those axes are separately tested

benchmark_exposure.collection_rule: Every new episode must start from a distinct real public procurement package, preserve the existing real/synthetic boundary, pass deterministic reference control, and be frozen before model-backed evaluation.

architecture_grammar.fixed_information_boundary: agent-visible state only; no episode-specific rules, hidden events, oracle fields, evaluator labels, or future-event access

search_procedure.candidate_representation: code-represented workflow assembled from the frozen module grammar; every candidate config and code hash must be committed before execution
search_procedure.candidate_generation: enumeration, recombination, or meta-agent proposal is allowed only inside the frozen grammar; every proposal must record parent candidates and module deltas

screening.purpose: cheap development screening; not confirmatory evidence

development_confirmation.baseline_policy: reuse frozen comparator evidence; do not rerun Coverage+Repair, ReAct, or factual context

ceiling_stop_rule.definition: Stop agent-design-pattern search after two consecutive completed search rounds add no candidate to the admissible validation Pareto frontier, or when max_rounds/max_unique_candidates is reached, whichever comes first.

economic_regret_v01.eligible_when: terminal award matches an acceptable feasible outcome, all hard constraints pass, economic objective kind is minimize_total_price, and all compared outcome prices use one native currency
economic_regret_v01.selected_cost: sum total_price for the quote_event_id referenced by each award in the matched acceptable outcome
economic_regret_v01.oracle_cost: minimum summed total_price across oracle preferred_outcome_ids
economic_regret_v01.infeasible_or_no_award_policy: report regret as not_eligible rather than assigning an arbitrary monetary penalty; reliability metrics carry the failure
economic_regret_v01.aggregation: report per-currency native regret separately and aggregate normalized regret percent; never sum different native currencies
economic_regret_v01.savings_contract: paired savings is baseline selected_cost minus candidate selected_cost only when both matched runs are regret-eligible; report native currency and percent

execution_requirements: zero setup, environment, evaluator, metadata, provider-call, or controller-contract failures
exact frozen model/settings and candidate code/config hashes
no episode-id branches, oracle access, evaluator labels, hidden-state access, or future-event access
development_promotion_branch: quality: improve feasible-obligation, strict, or economic success by at least 3/60 versus Coverage+Repair, with no other mandatory quality metric worse by more than 3/60 and cost no higher than frozen ReAct
efficiency: remain within 3/60 of Coverage+Repair on feasible-obligation, strict, and economic success, with regret no worse and at least 20% lower known API cost than Coverage+Repair

freeze_before_final_test: winning architecture code and module config
final comparison rows and statistical reporting procedure
method_claim_gate: quality branch: ProcureHarness improves feasible-obligation success by at least 3/30 over the better matched baseline, is no worse by more than 1/30 on strict and economic success, and costs no more than ReAct

efficiency branch: ProcureHarness is within 1/30 of the better matched baseline on feasible-obligation, strict, and economic success, has no worse normalized feasible-price regret, and reduces known API cost by at least 30% versus the better-quality matched baseline

phase2_after_pattern_freeze.entry_condition: Only after a ProcureHarness design-pattern winner is frozen from the architecture-search phase.
phase2_after_pattern_freeze.rule: Each harness axis requires a matched ablation on the frozen skeleton before it enters the final amalgamation.
